## Before merging

This repository publishes a Power BI project built on licensed data. Every change is checked against this list.

- [ ] No `.pbix` and no `cache.abf`: both carry the data inside.
- [ ] Nothing under `data/raw`, and no other file with customs records.
- [ ] No company names in the screenshots, the GIF, the video or the README.
- [ ] The `CarpetaDatos` parameter holds an example path, not a real one.
- [ ] No table typed by hand in the model with real rows.
- [ ] The figures quoted in the README still match the dashboard.
